title: Item Icon Request: Bucket, Bucket of Water, Bucket of Compost, Rope, Lockpick, Needle & Dead Plant  - RPG MAKER MZ

posts.author: Vaksky
posts.body:
Hello,
I'm looking for some icons that I couldn't find paid or free online.
Icons are following:
Bucket (empty)
Bucket of Water
Bucket of Compost
Rope
Lockpick
Needle
Dead Plant
This is for RPG Maker MZ so I believe they have to be 32x32. If anyone can help that will be much appreciated
The style doesn't really matter much to me. Just an object on a transparent background is good enough.

posts.author: Philly
posts.body:
I was able to create all the icons for you except for the needle. The icons are edits from the RPG Maker VX Ace Tileset & IconSet.
EDIT:
The icons can only be used if you also own RPG Maker VX Ace.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Avery has a huge number of from-scratch MV/Z icons in her
Icon Workshop
. Her 32px selection is somewhat smaller (especially if you don't own VXA) but there are some things you may be able to edit--for example, the stew pot into a bucket or the match into a needle (...I'm assuming you want a sewing needle? XD). Avery doesn't allow reposts or posting of edits, so unfortunately I can't do it for you.
She has almost everything you're looking for in 24px. If you're willing to use her icon frames to make them fit the 32px, these might work for you--
In the "Tools and Household Appliances" section, there's:
-Needle (with and without thread)
-Buckets (empty and with water, both wooden and metal pails)
-A metal key that could make for a passable bump key (not pick, but might do the job)
In "School and Office," there's a crowbar that could feasibly be turned into a lockpick/turning tool.
There isn't a specifically-dead plant, but there are tons of plants that you could edit into brown crunchiness. Weirdly, I also don't see a plain rope--but in the "Equipment" section, there are two different grappling hooks on rope that you could probably edit into being just ropes.
I hope something in there helps you!
